summary: Comprehensive testing of ticket filtering and custom inboxes feature. All 25 backend tests passed and all frontend UI tests passed. The filter engine correctly handles AND/OR logic, nested groups, text contains, date filters, is_none operator, and pagination. Custom inboxes CRUD and sharing work correctly. Frontend filter builder UI, save inbox modal, sidebar navigation, and 3-dot menus all function properly.
critical_code_review_comments: filter_tree_to_mongo() correctly handles recursive AND/OR groups with nested conditions
_condition_to_mongo() properly supports 15+ operators (is, is_not, contains, is_one_of, is_none, before, after, between, etc.)
Custom inbox sharing creates decoupled copies (not references) - good for independent editing
Pagination implemented correctly with skip/limit and has_more flag
Merged tickets are excluded from filter results by default
Frontend FilterBuilder properly uses data-testid attributes for all interactive elements
SaveInboxModal includes name input and color picker with 10 color options
test_credentials: Created temporary test user sessions in MongoDB for authenticated API tests
seed_data_creation: Used existing test user b1bbdaf9-5ac0-47a9-ac7d-31b0b149010e for UI testing, created temp sessions cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Filter and inbox feature is fully working. Key endpoints: POST /api/filter/tickets (server-side filtering), GET /api/filter/fields (available fields), CRUD /api/inboxes. Frontend components: FilterBuilder.js, SaveInboxModal.js, CustomInboxPage.js. Sidebar.js includes custom inboxes with 3-dot menu (edit/share/delete). Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_filter_inboxes.py covers all filter scenarios and can be used for regression.

backend.GET /api/filter/fields: Returns 12+ base fields (status, priority, source, assignee_id, created_at, title, etc.) with types and options
backend.POST /api/filter/tickets nested: Nested groups (brackets) work - (A AND B) OR C
backend.POST /api/inboxes: Creates inbox with filter_tree, color, name

frontend.filter_button: Opens FilterBuilder on click, shows count badge when active
frontend.filter_builder_ui: AND/OR toggle, field/operator/value dropdowns, add condition/group buttons
frontend.save_as_inbox_button: Appears when filter is active, opens SaveInboxModal
frontend.save_inbox_modal: Name input, 10 color options, Save/Cancel buttons
frontend.sidebar_custom_inboxes: Display under Tickets section with colored dots
frontend.custom_inbox_page: Shows inbox name, filters, and filtered tickets
